name: SWIR XBookmark
title: 10.23 BETA — QUEUE WATCH
friends_policy: Keep the 10.22 ACK-aware protocol unchanged: send 8/4, wait for incoming 8/4 ACK, then request 85 and ingest 159 rooms[]. 10.23 changes scheduling and diagnostics only.
queue_policy: Only one unresolved friend is retried at a time. NO_ACK gets up to two extra retry cycles with a 30s cooldown; ACK_NO_159 gets up to two extra cycles with an 18s cooldown. Busy WAIT_ACK/ACKED/WAIT_159 jobs are never interrupted.
snapshot_policy: 10.23 records decreases in serverFriends between fresh 159 observations so live testing can distinguish queue failures from snapshot replacement or cross-connection effects.
rooms_policy: Friends panel uses simple labels only: Znajomi, Pokoje/localization, Odśwież, Dodaj. APP/PC/SWIR/HONOUR decorations are not shown.
mix_policy: Confirmed 10.19 Color-aligned MIX 8/8 module is loaded unchanged.
honour_policy: Honour Probe remains rejected and is not loaded.
launcher_policy: Stable and Beta remain separate; 10.23 is current beta and 10.22 remains an immediate rollback for A/B comparison.
